fluff.overview:
The Taurian Defense Force assigns conventional infantry to garrison and planetary defense roles across the Concordat, where citizen-soldiers serve out of patriotic duty rather than mere obligation. Foot platoons form the garrison backbone of the TDF's infantry arm, cheap to equip and maintain on worlds where the Concordat's limited resources must stretch across dozens of systems. Since infantry regiments rarely rotate offworld, many battalions train as specialists in local terrain, and anti-BattleMech training is standard for all formations at battalion strength or greater.

Support squads operate portable or crew-served machine guns that deliver sustained automatic fire, providing suppression capability that can pin down enemy infantry and threaten light vehicles.
